set.tovw: Ruse/myth: the Green Bay paper called the $10,000 hoard mythical
set.n: Robbers torture a farmer for a 'mythical' $10,000 hoard, Eaton (1932)
set.st: Oct 1932: four young men held a household at Eaton for three hours, torturing the owner for a supposed $10,000 hoard. The Green Bay paper later called the hoard mythical; they got about $70. Pin is a record of the 1932 house site area.
